PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Could not reach {{thing}}
PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.text: It may be down for a moment. Try again.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.text: Wait a minute, then try again.

NOT_FOUND.title: This trip doesn't exist
NOT_FOUND.text: It may be deleted, or it isn't shared with you.

CONFLICT.title: This trip changed somewhere else
CONFLICT.text: Reload it to see the latest version. Your last change is not saved.

INVALID.title: Something went wrong
INVALID.text: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: You're logged out
UNAUTHORIZED.text: Log in again to see your trips.

OFFLINE.title: You're offline
OFFLINE.text: Check your connection, then try again.

INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong
INTERNAL.text: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
